heading_en: Approval Before the Application Date Concerning the Exclusion Exception for Calculating the ILM in the Standardized Measurement Approach
summary_ja: ILM算出に係る除外特例の承認につき、附則第十八条第一項・第二項を準用する。
summary_en: Article 18, paragraphs (1) and (2) of the Supplementary Provisions apply mutatis mutandis to approval of the exclusion exception for calculating the ILM.
paragraphs: Article 18, paragraphs (1) and (2) of the Supplementary Provisions apply mutatis mutandis to an Ultimate Designated Parent Company that intends to obtain approval concerning the exclusion exception for calculating the ILM in the standardized measurement approach under Article 295 of the New Public Notice. In this case, in Article 18, paragraph (1) of the Supplementary Provisions, the words "Article 287" shall be read as "Article 296" and the words "use of the ILM" as "exclusion exception for calculating the ILM", and in paragraph (2) of that Article, the words "Article 286, paragraph (1) or (2)" shall be read as "Article 295" and the words "those provisions" as "that Article".
